## Mova 1.5.1

Mova 1.5.1 是一个工程维护版本。官网样式源码已统一迁移到 SCSS，并提炼稳定的颜色、圆角、动效、字体和响应式断点变量；未使用的 Tailwind 构建集成已移除，官网生产样式体积进一步缩小。

本版本同时优化了 GitHub Actions 发布流水线：已通过 Pull Request 验证且内容未变化的提交可安全复用验证结果，Docker 构建相关 Action 已升级到 Node.js 24 运行时，从而减少重复构建和发布等待时间。

本版本不修改公开 HTTP/SSE 契约，不包含数据库迁移，也不要求重建缓存或重新扫描媒体库。现有部署可直接升级。

---

## Mova 1.5.1

Mova 1.5.1 is an engineering maintenance release. Website stylesheet sources now use SCSS consistently, with stable shared tokens for colors, radii, motion, typography, and responsive breakpoints. The unused Tailwind build integration has been removed, further reducing the production stylesheet size.

This release also streamlines the GitHub Actions release pipeline. Commits whose unchanged contents have already passed Pull Request validation can safely reuse those results, and Docker build actions now run on the Node.js 24 runtime, reducing redundant builds and release wait time.

This release does not change the public HTTP or SSE contract, contains no database migration, and requires no cache rebuild or media-library rescan. Existing deployments can upgrade in place.
